NABE is a national registration code used in the Danish healthcare system to designate "intensive observation" (*intensiv observation*) [^src1]. Within the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB), it is utilized alongside the codes NABB (intensive therapy) and NABC (intermediate observation) to identify and track the postoperative stays of high-risk patients [^src1]. 

The code is specifically tied to the database's quality measurement indicators. For the 2022–2023 reporting period, NABE served as a foundational data point for [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]], which evaluates intermediate admissions [^src1]. The 2023 figures for this indicator rely exclusively on clinical reports that applied the NABB, NABE, or NABC codes [^src1]. 

While these specific codes are central to AKDB's current reporting system, they are part of a broader national quality development framework. Due to ongoing critiques of the data foundation, strategic recommendations within the AKDB suggest a future transition toward standardized SOR codes to improve consistency and data quality across regions [^src1].
